{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_values = df['biomarker_baseline'].unique()

# Check for outliers in age
age_summary = df['age'].describe()

# Check for imbalance in treatment arms by sex
arm_sex_balance = pd.crosstab(df['sex'], df['arm'])

# Check if baseline biomarker differs by sex
baseline_by_sex = df.groupby('sex')['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Check distribution of baseline biomarker by sex
baseline_dist = df.groupby('sex')['biomarker_baseline'].describe()

sentinel_values, age_summary, arm_sex_balance, baseline_by_sex, baseline_dist"}
